title: Hourly Auto-Dig:Milken Institute Santa Monica location and women’s health update
summary: Global dataset-first selection enriched the Milken Institute with source-bounded Santa Monica office and reported-headquarters semantics, then ingested a material August 4 women’s health research publication and queued authoritative HQ resolution.

sources.title: Coverage and Reimbursement Roadmap for Women’s Health Innovation

data.research_question: What defensible current headquarters/location evidence can be attached to the Milken Institute, and what material current development has appeared since its July 31, 2026 roster refresh?
data.method: Searched the existing canonical Milken dataset and global Auto-Dig candidate universe, applied seeded two-stage dataset/topic then target selection with previous-three-run geographic/topic anti-repeat rules and an open-PR conflict exclusion, collected first-party and corroborating public location evidence, preserved headquarters attribution limits, then searched current post-refresh Milken news/research and ingested only a material new publication.
classification_rules: A public office address is not silently promoted to headquarters.
Organization-managed profile headquarters labels are attributed rather than treated as equivalent to first-party legal filings.
Lapsed LEI data is retained as stale corroboration, not current sole authority.
No coordinates are created without a defensible geocoder result.
Publication reporting remains attributed to the Milken Institute.

findings.selection_algorithm: dataset/topic-first deterministic random selection from the complete eligible set after recency, geography, and direct-conflict exclusions; then target selection inside the chosen dataset/topic
findings.actionable_target_count_note: The connector exposes the normalized queue and selected-dataset corpus, but the full Free-Range executable frontier could not be recomputed locally because direct GitHub DNS was unavailable and reconstructing the 1M+ document corpus was not proportionate. The selected-dataset target pool is exact.

findings.finding: First-party current evidence supports 1250 Fourth Street as a Santa Monica office. Current LinkedIn labels Santa Monica headquarters; a lapsed LEI record reports the exact street as headquarters. No coordinates were added because no geocoder result was collected.

scope: web search for Milken Institute August 2026 material updates
findings.finding: The August 4, 2026 women’s health reimbursement roadmap is a material post-refresh publication and was ingested as an attributed research-publication event. No newer headquarters change was found in the reviewed sources.
